scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chemdft/schemas typecheck && pnpm --filter @chemdft/scientific-scene typecheck && pnpm --filter @chemdft/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @chemdft/scientific-scene test && pnpm --filter @chemdft/web test && uv run --project services/api pytest
scripts.schemas:generate: uv run --project services/api python -m chemdft_api.contracts.generate && pnpm --filter @chemdft/schemas generate:typescript
scripts.schemas:check: uv run --project services/api python -m chemdft_api.contracts.generate --check && pnpm --filter @chemdft/schemas check:typescript
scripts.contracts:test: uv run --project services/api pytest tests/test_contracts.py tests/test_qcschema.py tests/test_tool_registry.py tests/test_result_firewall.py
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm schemas:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
